```sql
select
  cast(null as varchar) as key,
  cast(
    sum(case when o.status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end) * 1.0
    / nullif(count(*), 0)
    as decimal(38,12)
  ) as value
from orders o
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
where not o.is_test
  and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
  and ci.name = 'Chennai'
  and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
order by value
```
